Public Quirk Etiquette.text: Public Quirk etiquette in Japan is unwritten and firm: no Quirk use in public beyond what a body cannot help. People with Quirks that leak, glow, shed or drip keep them covered or contained on trains and in shops, and an apology follows any spark, gust or smell that escapes. Neighbors make room for larger heteromorphs without staring, and asking a stranger what their Quirk is counts as rude until the two know each other. Filming a stranger's Quirk is a serious breach, and posting the clip is worse. Showing off a Quirk at a party among friends is fine; doing it in a crowd marks a person as childish or a troublemaker. In Musutafu, with U.A. Academy above the city and hero fans everywhere, the rules hold as firmly as anywhere, and locals expect U.A. students in town to keep them best of all.
